overview: A silver chain that appears for centuries made by warlocks in the 15th century.

title: Order of the Dragon
overview: In a world teetering on chaos, elite assassin John Rico is the go-to solution when the government wants threats removed-quietly and permanently. But when a mission goes sideways, he's given one last shot at redemption: track down and eliminate Mason Ryker, the final ghost of the feared underground unit known as The Order of the Dragon. As Rico's mission leads him to a small, danger-ridden town in Serbia, the lines between good and evil begin to blur. Is Ryker the monster he's made out to be, or is there a deeper conspiracy at play? What begins as a black-and-white hit spirals into a moral storm-and time is running out.

title: Zero A.D.
overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

title: Focker-in-Law
overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

title: The Nights Before Christmas
overview: One Christmas Eve, Marty (Hynes), whose life is in a bit of a rut, finds himself wishing he had more time. Thanks to some holiday magic, he awakes the next morning to discover it's Christmas Eve – again. Confused at first, Marty learns to embrace his new normal and begins to truly appreciate the sights, sounds and people of New York City that previously went unnoticed. With this gift of time, he expands his world by learning how to play a new instrument, picking up new languages and reading...every single book. But when Marty meets Chloe (Mailey), a newly out-of-work journalist having a tough day, he falls hard for her. The only problem is that when the morning of December 24 comes once again, she doesn't know who he is. As the Christmas Eves continue to repeat themselves, Marty makes it his mission to win her over and, in the process, figure out what he needs to do to finally make his way to Christmas Day — hopefully with Chloe by his side.

title: A Danish Christmas
overview: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge and the two find a connection as well.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: river man
overview: As a homeless alcoholic struggles through withdrawal, haunting memories and creeping paranoia blur the line between reality and delusion

title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
original_title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
overview: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

title: All American Girls
overview: Directed by Conduit Films' founder Christy Wegener, All American Girls features a sit-down with Pleasant Rowland, as well as never-before-seen footage and insights from the American Girl brand's authors, insiders, enthusiasts and journalists. Stop-motion graphics aid the filmmakers as they venture behind the curtain of the brand, which shaped the lives of generations of Americans in the ’80s, ’90s and early 2000s, and maintains cultural relevance today.

title: Jeffrey Dollmer
overview: Models on a photo shoot are stalked by a doll possessed by the spirit of serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

title: Marge
overview: After learning she’s pregnant, Sadie reflects back on the night she learned her mother was a serial killer. But now becoming a mother herself, Sadie suddenly finds herself understanding Marge in a way she never has before.

title: The Fall of Barsisa
overview: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.

title: There's Room For Two In Here
original_title: There's Room For Two In Here

title: Isolation

title: The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End
original_title: The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End
overview: Caffeine-deprived Cand Caff’s day goes from bad to apocalyptic when his sentient fridge threatens to blow up the entire neighborhood unless he delivers a fresh energy drink — fast. What follows is a chaotic sprint filled with push-up battles, Karen attacks, and unhinged inner demons in this pitch-black, low-budget comedy.  The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End cranks the absurdity, self-loathing, and dark humor to eleven while somehow feeling like the start of something much bigger.

title: Little Wing
overview: Little Wing is an intimate short film exploring grief, longing, and the ways loss is carried in the body. It is a journey into grief, miscarriage, and the connection you have with your child, and yourself, in the aftermath of this.

title: Three Arugula Salads
overview: Young professional Chelsea unravels during the course of a women's-only work lunch as she realizes that it's easier for her coworkers to betray each other than to challenge their toxic corporate culture.

title: Ahyoka

Weaving her own life with a traditional Cherokee story about a crooked-face boy, Ahyoka traces how exclusion was never a Cherokee value and reminds us what it truly means to be a Keetoowah person.

title: Next Time

title: Meat

title: Midnight Murungai

title: James McNeill Whistler
overview: Tate Britain is now holding the first major retrospective of Whistler in three decades. This blockbuster exhibition promises to reawaken the world to just how important Whistler is to art history, uniting world-famous masterpieces with rarely seen works. Exhibition on Screen will bring these stunning works and the incredible story behind them to cinemas around the world while the exhibition is still running, bringing this truly global artist to a global audience. This will be an unmissable chance to get to know this visually spectacular artist and the influence he has had on those who followed.

title: Homeward
overview: Some visitors descend into what appears to be a luxury bunker. There they find the end of the world.

title: Buddies

title: Strong Son

title: Pretenders

title: Purgatory

As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: Ratrace
overview: What would you do if you found a bag full of money?

As unexplained phenomena multiply throughout the forest, the brothers are forced into a confrontation with an environment that defies explanation — a place where the rules of time bend, and the past may never have truly disappeared.

title: The Girl in the River

title: Going to McDonald's to get the Hello Kitty Godzilla Happy Meal Toy

title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban
original_title: I Constantly Thank God for Esteban

While at her home, the kids make Carmen painfully aware of her religious upbringing, ultimately stealing her First Communion dress, culminating in a final showdown at their local roller rink.

Between spontaneous confessions and heavy silences, each of them reveals fragments of who they are and who they wish to be. But some truths are hard to face, and not all stories follow the path we imagine.

title: Soul Snatchers
overview: A man of unwavering convictions returns with his family to the remote island of his childhood to open a music school for orphaned children, but beneath the island's beauty lies an unseen darkness.

title: Claire McKenna

Anxiously awaiting her parole officer, Claire discovers something from her old life that suddenly puts her fragile new beginning into question.  To everyone around her, the moment may seem insignificant. For Claire, it’s a fierce and deeply personal battle to remain sober, honest, and alive.

title: Erased

title: Fork in the Road
overview: Fork in the Road is an intimate documentary that explores the profound connections between people, the land, and the future of our food system. Through a tapestry of compelling stories from independent small-scale farmers across the United States, from Alaskan kelp harvesters to dairy farmers in Kentucky, the film reveals the authentic, lived realities and unprecedented challenges of those working against the tide of escalating industrialization in agriculture. Featuring insights from visionary chefs and culinary experts, Fork in the Road expands the conversation beyond the farm, demonstrating how food sustainability is a shared responsibility that extends into our kitchens and communities. More than a call to environmental action, the film illuminates the vital ways that sustainable food practices can nourish our bodies, strengthen our communities, and heal the Earth.

title: Violent Delight
overview: A lonely artist draws her perfect companion-but the more he sees her, the more she loses herself.

title: Guerrilla Filmmaker
overview: A documentary about ultra-low budget guerrilla filmmaking, deep in the heart of Texas.

title: King KOSOKO
overview: Warrior Kosoko, grandson of King Ologun Kutere, survives childhood curses to become a formidable prince. When his father, Esinlokun, dies, Kosoko is sidelined as his younger brother Idewu and later his uncle Adele Ajosun usurp the throne. Kosoko bides his time, amassing wealth through trade and alliances.

title: Keo: Live at Reading Festival 2026
overview: Carrying the torch for 90s alt-rock, the fast-rising London band open Friday.

title: Blood Secret
overview: From Cameron Francis, director of last year’s FrightFest acclaimed breakout hit, COVER. Secrets... Lies... Bodies... Nothing stays buried forever. While visiting her best friend, a woman starts to question reality when she's confronted by seemingly supernatural events. As her sanity unravels, she comes to the terrifying realization that she might not survive the night. Set in one location, but given an epic look in John Carpenter-inspired wide-screen, claustrophobia, both mentally and physically, is the overwhelming mood of Francis’ latest miniature gem exploring the universal themes of regret, remorse and ultimately searching for forgiveness.

title: For Deer Life
overview: Beneath the beauty of spring lies a brutal tragedy… The birth of roe deer fawns coincides with the mowing season in Austria’s meadows, leading to a brutal struggle between nature and modern agriculture. “For Deer Life” tells the story of the dedicated drone operators, who put their heart and soul into rescuing the lives of as many fawns as possible. The film highlights the powerful combination of innovative use of thermal drones and the unwavering commitment of volunteers, to prevent this tragic loss of life. With the aim to inspire both a local and global audience to embrace technology as a conservation means, emphasising the harmonious balance between agriculture and wildlife protection.

title: Lengwìa
overview: After an agonizing school year bruises his relationship with his well-liked older brother Jonah, socially awkward Teddy meets Cole, a disarming boy, by chance on the street. As their friendship deepens, actions begin to speak louder than words, unraveling the fragile balance between brotherhood, belonging, and yearning during a blistering summer break.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: Paroxysm

title: The Great Wall of China with Dan Snow
original_title: The Great Wall of China with Dan Snow
overview: The historian heads to China to find out more about the country's iconic landmark – the world's biggest building project that changed the course of Chinese history.

title: American Martyr: The Stanley Rother Story
original_title: American Martyr: The Stanley Rother Story
overview: After struggling with his studies in the seminary, a young priest from Oklahoma discerns his call to serve Guatemala’s native people, no matter the cost. Hosted by Fr. Charles Connor.

title: Flowers of the Earth
overview: "Water lives in our bodies," a Kaiowá poet once said. "It evaporates into the air, becomes a cloud of love, falls as rain, sprouts the buds, blooms the flowers. We are Nature." For the Guarani-Kaiowá of Mato Grosso do Sul, there is no line where the body ends and the land begins. The earth is their skin, the tree their umbilicus, the mountains the bones of a living mother. But for over a century, that mother has been fenced, burned, mined, and poisoned, her children pushed onto slivers of the territory that once held them all. The film listens to the elders who remember the forest before the farmers came, before the native were clear-cut and the living land was carved into square plots of a single endless crop.

title: The Silence After the Rain
overview: A christian poet uses a pagan ritual to summon the spirit of his deceased daughter.

title: Never Stop Chasing
overview: A documentary portrait of storm chaser Reed Timmer, who was an inspiration for Glen Powell’s character in Twisters.

title: The House

With his grandson Nikola, who has Asperger's syndrome and is living without social contacts, he travels to his homeland, a village in Serbia, to sell the family land, but becomes a part of a local population rebellion against the construction mafia that threatens to destroy everything that is left of his homeland.

title: Mouse
overview: When a lonely petty thief begins a correspondence with the woman of his dreams, two competing fantasies collide in an unexpectedly human story about loneliness, class, and the desperate need to belong.

title: Aurora

title: Amongst Men

title: Three Black Men

Three Black men set out on a transformative journey along the transatlantic slave route in reverse, exploring resistance, liberation and a new understanding of Blackness.  Their epic voyage takes them from Los Angeles to Salvador da Bahia in Brazil, and finally to Accra in Ghana. Their mission is to redefine Blackness, heal from historical trauma, and envision new paths to liberation beyond the constraints of white supremacy.

title: South of Seattle

title: Shutterbug

title: Coconut

Ashamed of his Australian accent and mocked by community members whenever he speaks Fiji Hindi, he has given up on his family's language. His cultural displacement comes to a head when he accidentally ruins his grandpa's Hindu funeral ceremony, knocking the urn containing his ashes into the nearby creek. Everything changes when his sharp-tongued, non-English-speaking grandma hears Dev swear at a stranger and responds in kind. Their new secret language becomes a bridge across grief and a way back into culture and language.

The Minusio Tapes is a study in what survives concealment: how the past insists on being found, one recording at a time.  Produced under the creative supervision of Ramon Zürcher and Silvan Zürcher during the Locarno Film Festival 2026 Spring Academy.

title: Rage of Stars

overview: After being mistaken for his twin brother by his estranged and dying dad, a soft-spoken trans man relishes the opportunity to be one of the boys, until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

title: Manhunt
overview: Inspired by the real 2019 Northern British Columbia manhunt when two teenage boys from Vancouver Island murdered three strangers and fled north through ghost towns and endless forest. Their flight, live-tracked across social media and news feeds, unfolded like a fever dream of the digital age: an openworld simulation of fear and fascination. Weeks later, their bodies were found by a river, the chase ending as abruptly as it began.

title: One Night Only
overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

title: Pasear a un perro
overview: On another monotonous night in Javier's life, he goes out to walk his dog while thinking about the movie he just saw, not knowing that a small event is going to take him out of his depressing routine.

title: Baggage Claim
overview: Upon learning of their mother's untimely death, lone-stoner Abby and type-A brother Ben must embark on a body identification road trip home to claim her corpse - along with their own personal baggage.

title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
original_title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
overview: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

title: Poster Boy: Becoming Zyzz
overview: Explores the rise, impact, and enduring mythology of Aziz Shavershian – “Zyzz” – the unlikely internet icon whose transformation from anonymous teenager to global symbol of fitness culture reshaped how a generation defines influencers, identity, and self-invention.

title: Ice Twister
overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

title: Before Never
overview: When Wendy Darling escapes an attempted abduction, her family employs James and Smee to identify the attacker with the help of the only eyewitness: Peter Pan.

title: The Cover Story
overview: Inside an ordinary home, a plastic cover speaks not as waste, but as a ruler. From the smallest household corner, it declares its dominance.

title: The Unelected Statesman
overview: Billy Graham was a man known worldwide for his southern charm, unmistakable voice and most importantly to him, his love and devotion to Jesus Christ. Lesser known, however, is his role as a statesman of the United States. Despite never holding public office, Graham comforted the nation in some of its darkest hours, spread its causes and principles to all corners of the globe, and counseled every president from Harry Truman to George W. Bush. This is the story of the unelected statesman.

title: Ottamaram
overview: It revolves around an elderly couple—Ravi and Bharathi—who have been living separately to cater to the needs and commitments of their children.

title: Sky to Soil
overview: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

title: So Far and From Now On
original_title: So Far and From Now On
overview: Set in post-pandemic Los Angeles, Ellie tries to rebuild her life through a small online lamp shop after thirty months in jail. Yet encounters with both familiar faces and strangers draw her back to the fear she thought she had escaped.

title: Freaks Part II
overview: Several years after a traumatic escape, we meet Mary and her daughter Chloe as they live on the road, hiding their powers and identities. They are hunted by the Abnormal Defense Force, paramilitary police that specialize in ruthlessly exterminating ‘freaks‘ like them. Mary is fueled by revenge, determined to find the ADF officer who killed her first child.

title: Be Merry
overview: Raised in 1980s Russell by Merry, an artist whose life became local folklore, filmmaker Gwen Isaac returns to her Far North hometown to untangle fact from family legend and confront the inheritance she carries into her own motherhood.

title: The Messenger
overview: In 1800s Fiji, Kaliti must battle both man & nature to save her village from impending doom.

title: Echoes
overview: A girl enters an old attic that seems to be frozen in time. Between forgotten objects, an old radio and the warm light coming through the windows, she discovers a small hidden world: an old circus tent from another time. As she explores the room, something begins to come back. Distant children's voices, forgotten laughter and strange feelings appear, as if the attic is holding memories from the past.  The room is not empty. It still keeps the echoes of the people and moments that once lived there.

title: The G Series
overview: E.C. Lewin presents The G Series, an anthology of short films created from 2024 to 2026.

title: Drywall
overview: A small-town sheriff investigates a violent incident on a rural road that leads him to a secluded property where nothing is what it seems.

title: My Happy Place
overview: A burned-out office worker discovers a hidden passage to a vibrant bar where he’s effortlessly loved and admired. As this secret escape transforms his confidence and identity, he begins to change in his real life too, forcing him to confront a difficult choice between staying in the fantasy or fully embracing reality.

title: Marble Tears Taste Like Wine
overview: A volatile chess prodigy struggling with anger management attempts to navigate a world that feels hostile, dismissive, and chaotic. While chess offers him control and identity, real life repeatedly provokes his buried rage. After fleeting moments of connection and hope, a final altercation spirals into irreversible violence, forcing him to confront the devastating cost of losing control.

title: Endless Ride: TOMORROW X TOGETHER VR Concert
original_title: Endless Ride: TOMORROW X TOGETHER VR Concert
overview: Step into TOMORROW X TOGETHER VR CONCERT : ENDLESS RIDE, an immersive concert experience that brings you closer to TXT than ever before.

title: The Soap Star Murder Mystery
overview: A soap star moves to the suburbs after a terrifying stalking incident. A shocking murder pulls her into a web of intrigue where no one can be trusted.

title: The Green Monster
overview: A Christmas gathering turns horrific when a family’s inherited home is discovered to be haunted by a legend known as the Green Monster.

title: Scotty
overview: A stray cat (Scotty) has to travel with a pet cat (Katie) despite his desire to return to his territory, but when he gets home, he realizes that living with those he loves is better than living alone.

title: Pink Floyd Live Dortmund 1981
overview: Super 8mm Of The Second German Pink Floyd Wall Show At The Westfalenhalle on February 14th, 1981

title: Garden
overview: Apparatus Screen presents Purgatorio

title: While They Were Away
overview: A day home alone during the summer of my freshman year of college.

title: PotatoHead
overview: Robert Relish, an aspiring Far Right social media influencer struggles to keep balance in his carefully crafted "life" he presents online as he dodges his blind girlfriend Olivia and slowly preys on someone online doing what he does but better.

title: Visions of you instil hallucinations.
overview: Visions of a God’s journey.

title: Washing Machine Heart
overview: A surrealist/experimental internet short film about grief.

title: Rowe's Realm of Horror
overview: An outdoor haunt. A deadly after-hours secret. You're never alone.

title: AMUCK
overview: A man who laments "not even feeling like the main character of his own story" suddenly finds himself aware of the camera that's watching him, eliciting a mind-bending journey of self discovery.

title: Cherish
overview: A woman comes to terms with what has been taken from her due to her old age.

title: The Legend of Yella George
overview: A man's wife mysteriously goes missing one night. All evidence points towards the husband. As detectives dive deeper into the case, a local legend begins to twist itself into the case, confusing detectives and the husband. Nightmares, death, and mystery surround this story with an ending no one could see coming.
